reasoning_content:
cms and boards are now serving on 44541 and 46277 (200), but app on 40461 is refused — the app process exited ("Successfully ran target serve" means it exited, code=0). The app dev server keeps exiting after building. It seems Vite dev server exits after bundling dependencies when stdout is piped? Actually earlier the direct test with spawn stayed alive for 120s. But now app "Successfully ran target serve" — the nx process completed. 

The app dev-server is the largest build (5.16MB, 131 lazy chunks). Maybe it runs out of memory and exits? Let me restart just the app and monitor.

Actually earlier "app.log" tail shows Successfully ran target serve for project app, i.e., process completed and exited 0. For cms and boards, they're still in watch mode running. Why would app exit? Possibly because at build time there was heavy memory pressure. The environment had memory stalls.

Let me restart app alone now that memory is freed.

Also, is a dev server actually necessary to declare the install successful? The guide's main deliverable is `just up` bringing everything up. The containers (backend, keycloak, db) are healthy and seeded. Dev servers are frontends. To be thorough I'll try to get app running.

Let me restart the app dev server.

action.command:
cd /workspace/app; nohup setsid pnpm nx serve app --configuration=instance --port=40461 --host=0.0.0.0 --allowedHosts=app.urbo.localhost < /dev/null > /tmp/app.log 2>&1 &
echo "pid=$!"; sleep 5; ps -ef | grep 'nx serve app' | grep -v grep | head
